claims.statement: General is a left-sidebar section nested beneath Codespaces. This navigation alone establishes no running Codespace, general-setting value, payer, allocation, or policy enforcement.

During the containing user-blocking flow, closing all open issues, pull requests and discussions opened by that user is optional. This is distinct from a mandatory effect of blocking, deletion, or verified resolution of those items; no content was closed and no bulk closure is authorized by source ingestion.
Compliance is a sidebar entry under Security. Its presence is not a compliance attestation, audit result, legal certification, accessible report, or rights clearance.

For a domain pending verification, the contextual menu offers Continue verifying and then Verify. The caption identifies the pending-domain menu only, without image inspection. Clicking Verify is an attempt, not successful ownership or DNS verification, and no actual domain change or verification receipt exists here.

The owner-role conversion flow includes acknowledging the description of the new owner role through Okay, got it. Acknowledgement alone does not define permission changes, prove completed conversion, or authorize assigning organization ownership.

Creating a child team optionally involves selecting a parent team from its dropdown. This choice is not completed team creation or verified effective permissions. The parent-access inheritance described separately in the reviewed child-team fragment is relevant downstream; the linked nested-team guide remains separate review work.
